gloss: to leave, to go away, to depart

examples.english: Don't chase after those who leave.

examples.japanese: ⟦{故郷|こきょう}→故郷：02733_kokyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{去|さ}る。
⟦{職場|しょくば}→職場：04164_shokuba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{去|さ}ることにした。
examples.english: I decided to leave the workplace.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦{働|はたら}いた→働く：00503_hataraku⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{去|さ}る⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{寂|さび}しかった→寂しい：00880_sabishii⟧。
examples.english: It was sad to leave the company where I had worked for many years.

examples.japanese: ⟦{痛|いた}み→痛み：01795_itami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{去|さ}ったあと、ようやく⟦{眠|ねむ}る→眠る：01181_nemuru⟧ことが⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: After the pain passed, I was finally able to sleep.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{舞台|ぶたい}→舞台：03606_butai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{去|さ}ったあと⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{拍手|はくしゅ}→拍手：03553_hakushu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦しばらく→しばらく：01267_shibaraku⟧⟦{続|つづ}いていた→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: Even after he left the stage, the applause continued for a while.

notes:
{去|さ}る is a literary verb meaning to leave or depart, more formal than ⟦{離|はな}れる→離れる：02397_hanareru⟧ or ⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive)
- Takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ particle to mark the place being left

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{去|さ}る: to leave a place
- ⟦{故郷|こきょう}→故郷：02733_kokyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{去|さ}る: to leave one's hometown
- ⟦{時|とき}→時：02918_toki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{去|さ}る: time passes
- ⟦{嵐|あらし}→嵐：01695_arashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{去|さ}る: the storm passes

PROVERBS:
- {去|さ}る⟦{者|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{追|お}わず→追う：02016_ou⟧: Don't chase those who leave
- {去|さ}る⟦{者|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧⟦{日日|ひび}→日々：04804_hibi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{疎|うと}し→疎い：07842_utoi⟧: Out of sight, out of mind

IN COMPOUNDS:
{去|きょ} reading in compounds: ⟦{去年|きょねん}→去年：00727_kyonen⟧ (last year), ⟦{過去|かこ}→過去：00152_kako⟧ (the past)

DON'T CONFUSE:
⟦{猿|さる}→猿：02213_saru⟧ (monkey) has the same reading.

ASPECT (ている):
- {去|さ}っている: has (already) departed (resultative state)
- Note: {去|さ}る is a punctual verb of leaving, so the ている form describes the state of being gone, not the act of leaving. ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{既|すで}に→既に：01581_sudeni⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{去|さ}っている means "he has already left town" (he's gone). The past form {去|さ}った is more common for a simple "has left" event.
